note: Every check a data run must pass before it publishes. Only a run that passes them all is published, so the live data's run reads pass; a failing run's data never reaches the site.

gates.name: Book weights
gates.fails_when: A tracked fund's equity weights add up to more than 0.1% away from 100%.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Alert routing index
gates.fails_when: The fund index lacks a field the API routes alerts by, or has no hedge-fund or long-only manager.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Tracked funds current
gates.fails_when: A tracked fund has a newer 13F-HR on EDGAR that this build did not load.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Holder counts
gates.fails_when: A stock's all-filer holder count is below the number of tracked funds holding its common shares.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Filer type drift
gates.fails_when: A filer type's count moves more than 10% (and by more than 10 filers) against the live set without a reviewed reclass.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Reviewed filer types
gates.fails_when: A hand-reviewed filer comes out of the build with a different type.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Splits applied
gates.fails_when: A position in a stock with a split on file reads as a trade the split explains.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Acceptance times
gates.fails_when: A tracked fund's holder row has no EDGAR acceptance time.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Row provenance
gates.fails_when: A full book has no source accession or first-disclosed time on any row.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: One filer per book
gates.fails_when: Another filer's 13F is merged into a book outside a 13F-NT succession.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Book totals
gates.fails_when: A book merged from several filings totals more than 1.5x its filed cover, or more than 1.5x the prior quarter with the median position up more than 1.6x.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Ticker coverage
gates.fails_when: Holdings value with a ticker falls more than 0.5 points against the live data.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Tickers kept
gates.fails_when: Any of the 1,000 largest CUSIPs loses the ticker it had in the live data.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Share-class sums
gates.fails_when: More than 10 multi-class holder rows differ from the sum of their classes, or any does in a top-100 stock by value.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Holder net and counts
gates.fails_when: A stock's net or change counts differ from the sum of its own holder rows.
gates.stays_live: Nothing is published: the live data stays.

gates.name: Holders net = changes
gates.fails_when: Any stock's holder-index net differs from the sum of its counted changes rows for the same quarter.
gates.stays_live: The previous holder index and changes stay; everything else publishes and the run is marked failed.
